body:
Final independent review: ACCEPTED for the implemented authored, profile-structural domain boundary, with the explicit source-fidelity gate retained for any future pruning, obligation discharge, propagation, or bidirectional consumer.

Checks reproduced against the integrated tree with `PYTHONPATH=src:tests python .codex/state/proof-contract-analysis/final-audit/reproduce_final.py`: forged comparison summary rejected after exact-input recomputation; anchored constant/witness known permission mismatch rejected; a permission on a later forall rejected at the existential choice point; unresolved external source-map owner rejected by batch closure (the individual artifact remains shape-valid); checker-authority provenance promotion rejected; injected mid-replacement SQLite failure rolled back and retained the old projection, with foreign_key_check clean.

Negative consumer probe (inline Python invoking evaluate_derivation and correspondence_check._check_slice) confirms the comparison has source-contract-binding-unchecked, cannot structurally satisfy a formal derivation, is rejected as a source slice, and validation rejects removal of that limitation. `rg -n "compare_contracts|proofir\.contract-analysis|profile-structural|proofir\.contract" src/ladon` outside the dedicated contract/native validation and projection modules found no production consumer. Contract records remain attributed-unreviewed with no checker authority; the comparison result is profile-structural and mathematical falsity is not established. The Lean fixture/evidence states its natural-valued uninterpreted scale scope; it does not prove source extraction fidelity or arbitrary analytic norm facts. Rust explicitly rejects the two new kinds.

The pre-fix constant-anchor mismatch finding (#62) is resolved by the integrated coherence validator and profile digest entry; current reproduction rejects it. Unknown/unsupported feature states remain non-comparable. The design's producer, propagation, bidirectional, and evaluation work remains outside this accepted implementation boundary. No production or frozen-test edits were made by this audit.

Reproduction commands/evidence: `PYTHONPATH=src:tests python .codex/state/proof-contract-analysis/final-audit/reproduce_final.py`; inline consumer probe described above; SQLite rollback is part of the scratch script. Root's recorded verification is post63 (8 targeted, 411 broader before coherence update); no test-suite rerun by this auditor.
